rongmei.title: Gun daipui tingmik tang khang na the

lines: 1. Gun daipui ting mik tang khang na the,
Cham lou mei guang le kandi cham pan guai;
Kao thu ruina khuang pui le baza rui,
Ata kao e kanlou mei pu rui.
Gundaipui tingmik khou ,
Kallou khang cham dan na bam mo
Kaguang bam pang khou ding khang tei
Poubaomei tan hei tan dikho.
2. Reinung Noah rui ring pui gan ta,
Ningtou lana simei guai gan ngam mo;
Man ngam puni aniu kandi hei mu,
Gulou puni cham pan jat goi ta.
3. Kachak nam dai khou guang tang pukhou ,
Miram khou tei aniu mban thaini;
Lung rian ramei le kapmei nai lak khe;
Gulou meinah nun le bam cham ni.
4. Kandih khou gaimei ta ai ning the,
Hei ramgai khou tei guang tang nipui nung;
Guang guai na guang poubaomei daimei ta,
Ringpui san thuan bam ni khrista ta.
